**Hint 2**
For each row $$$r$$$, we need to find the size of the component formed by filling row $$$r$$$ (i.e. the size of the component containing row $$$r$$$ if we set all cells in row $$$r$$$ to be $$$\texttt{#}$$$). The size of the component containing row $$$r$$$ if we set all cells in row $$$r$$$ to be $$$\texttt{#}$$$ will be the sum of: The number of $$$\texttt{.}$$$ in row $$$r$$$ since these cells will be set to $$$\texttt{#}$$$. Let $$$F_r$$$ denote this value for some row $$$r$$$. The sum of sizes of components containing a cell in either row $$$r-1$$$, $$$r$$$, or $$$r+1$$$ (i.e. components that are touching row $$$r$$$). This is since these components will be part of the component containing row $$$r$$$. Let $$$R_r$$$ denote this value for some row $$$r$$$. The challenge is computing the second term quickly.
